name: program-runtime.scenario-deploy-report
purpose: Read a bounded summary of one scenario's deploy report without exposing build values, capture ids, host roots or environment values.
assumptions: The root Vrooli control plane is reachable.
invariants: Calls only vrooli/scenario/deploy-report with a scenario slug.
At most 50 artifact summaries and 100 each of changed paths, build key names and environment switch names are retained.
Only repo-relative changed paths and names are returned; values, source roots, capture ids and file contents are omitted.

signals.truncated: true when a cap was reached
